title: Worker daemon identity (minion.local-status.daemon/1)
$comment: The daemon{} object of the worker_status reply on the local control socket and of `minion worker status --json`. Local only: it is never sent to the Hub and never published. instance is one random id per daemon process. A daemon older than this contract sends no daemon{}; the CLI then shows the instance of the old reply alone. Absent means not known, never zero. started_at is RFC 3339 UTC (the socket reply keeps fractional seconds, the CLI report uses milliseconds). Top-level version of the CLI report stays the version of the CLI; connection.live stays socket-confirmed.

pid.description: Operating system process id; informative only.
